findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_artwork · Private data: get_order_status, open_claim, start_purchase, confirm_purchase · Public sink: start_purchase · Destructive: get_artwork.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_artwork · Private data: get_order_status, open_claim, start_purchase, confirm_purchase · Public sink: start_purchase · Destructive: get_artwork

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
